recentItems.title: Bata, Bata... Paano Ka Ginawa?' FULL MOVIE | Vilma Santos, Carlo Aquino
recentItems.description:
Based on the acclaimed novel of Lualhati Bautista, this film looks into the life of women's rights advocate Lea Bustamante (Vilma Santos), who has two children from different fathers. She finds herself at a crossroads when her children's fathers propose taking their kids with them. She then decides to let her children choose who they want to stay with. Released in 1998 and directed by Chito S. Roño.

Starring Vilma Santos, Ariel Rivera, Albert Martinez, Carlo Aquino, and Serena Dalrymple.
